label: Formal fact: on an order of being by approach to a…, via attribution restricts cause more such
meaning: Formal fact, from no premises: on the reading by attribution with strict primacy, Aristotle's cause-is-more-such principle holds for the primary and fails in general. So at being the frontier premise STMT-CAUSE-OF-QUALITY-IN-ANOTHER-IS-MORE-SUCH needs re-reading: restricted to the primary as cause it is derivable from the order by approach and strict primacy (an open premise, STMT-NOTHING-ELSE-REACHES-THE-PRIMARY); the unrestricted proposition goes beyond the synonymous reading of Met. II.1. The attribution-order restriction and synonymy are distinct conditions.
